OBJECT Codeunit 50012 Identifier Casing
{
  OBJECT-PROPERTIES
  {
    Date=21.11.26;
    Time=12:00:00;
    Modified=Yes;
    Version List=TEST;
  }
  PROPERTIES
  {
  }
  CODE
  {
    VAR
      GlobalCounter@1000 : Integer;

    PROCEDURE RunTask@1(InputValueP@1000 : Integer);
    VAR
      ItemLedgEntryL@1001 : Record 32;
    BEGIN
      // CAL012: variable and procedure references must match declaration casing
      GlobalCounter := InputValueP;
      ItemLedgEntryL.SETRANGE("Entry No.", GlobalCounter);
      IF ItemLedgEntryL.FINDFIRST() THEN
        HelperProc();
    END;

    LOCAL PROCEDURE HelperProc@2();
    BEGIN
      MESSAGE('%1', GlobalCounter);
    END;

    BEGIN
    END.
  }
}
